Question: Do Ukrainians trust the U.S. as a partner anymore?

Ukrainian MP Yulia Sirko: “I think Ukrainians understand…there is no realistic peace talks…over months and even more, we understand that we have to be self-sufficient and to produce enough weapons to defend ourselves and that our future most probably is more with Europe than with the U.S. Unfortunately.”
